scenes.description: I’m in a living room with a long white counter and wooden stools in front of me. There are wood cabinets and shelves with books or movies on the left. A couch is partly visible nearby, and the floor is light tile.

There is a doorway to a bathroom to my right. There is a sink and toilet in the bathroom. There is a light brown closet in front of me, to the left of the bathroom's doorway, in a cornet. To the left of the closet there is a white door. There is a grey doormat laying in front of the door.
I’m in a small kitchen area with a black fridge in front of me. A sink and wood cabinets are on the left. The floor is brown, and the walls are light colored.

There is a twin bed in front of me. There are 4 pillows of the bed. The bedding is fully white. The outside of the bed frame is brown and it is grey inside. On the left side from the bed, there is a bedside table, There is a phone, an alarm clock, a lamp, a note with a pen, and a bottle of water on top of it.

I’m facing a crowded storage corner with plastic bins, drawer units, and folded clothes stacked around the walls. A dark cabinet or mini fridge sits on the left, with another bin on top of it. In front of me are more clear containers holding blankets, and the floor is light wood.
There is a large printer in front of me to the left. There is paper in the printer. On the front right there is blue floor with some yellow and black cords laying
I’m in a sitting area with tan chairs around a small black table. There is a book or folder on the table. The floor has patterned carpet, with white tile farther back.

I’m looking at a bathroom vanity with two sinks and light wood cabinets underneath. The counter has cups, bottles, toothbrushes, and other bathroom items on it. A toilet is partly visible on the right, and the floor is light tile.
There is a red carpet on the floor. There is a coffee table with two chairs. There is a power socket with a power cable. There is a black baseboard on the wall.
I’m looking up a small stairwell with light steps. There is a black handrail on the left wall and another rail on the right. The light is dim, and the walls look yellow.
